description: Vulnerabilidade Costeira - EROSÃO COSTEIRA - Região SUL - PEM/PGGM/SECIRM is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Informações compiladas do Livro "Panorama da Erosão Costeira no Brasil", publicado pelo Programa de Geologia e Geofísica Marinha (PGGM) e Ministério do Meio Ambiente (MMA), em 2018. Organizado pelo Prof. Dr. Dieter Muehe, 761 págs. Região sul do Brasil, englobando os estados do Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Santa Catarina. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are BRASIL, Planejamento Espacial Marinho (PEM), Programa de Geologia e Geofísica Marinha (PGGM), Vulnerabilidade Costeira, Erosão Costeira. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
